evidence.evidence: Biomarker Matrix v1.1 is recorded as the reviewed implementation baseline in docs/SCIENTIFIC_GOVERNANCE.md and docs/SCIENTIFIC_BASELINE_V1_1.md.
P17 deterministic replay and no-imputation tests pass in the repository test suite.

Browser walkthrough (headless Chromium 1280x1800, local dev origin) of the Mission Day 127 critical story: / -> /mission/live -> /mission/readiness -> /mission/intelligence -> /mission/guidance -> /mission/offline -> /mission/ground -> /mission/simulation -> /mission/validation. Every route rendered with its own title, exactly one <main> and one <h1>, zero console/page errors and zero horizontal overflow. Mission -> Mission Scenario resolved to /mission/simulation and About -> Validation & Limitations navigated to /mission/validation (title 'Validation & Usability | The Mitochondria'). No broken navigation observed.

Keyboard-only review on / and /mission/live. Tab order reached logo, skip/section links, all six top-level menu triggers, the external NASA link and hero actions; on /mission/live it reached Readiness, Public site, Connect BLE heart rate, the self-check select, the note input and Record check-in. Focus is visible via :focus-visible (document.activeElement.matches(':focus-visible') true; ring box-shadow oklch(0.79 0.145 206) 1px). Menus open with Enter, move with ArrowDown to role=menuitem, and close with Escape. The self-check select opened with Enter, changed value by ArrowDown+Enter ('Monitor / not at best'), and Record check-in activated with Enter, producing the 'Last recorded at' confirmation. No keyboard trap and no hover-only control encountered.

Responsive/touch review at 390x844 with touch and mobile emulation. All nine critical routes reported 0px horizontal overflow and no page errors. The mobile navigation opened by tap into a role=dialog panel and body overflow became 'hidden' (scroll lock). Primary buttons and menu rows met touch sizing. Observation, not a blocker: inline footer/menu text links render about 20px tall, below a 24px box, and are documented for future refinement rather than claimed as fully compliant.
P11 automated test verifies the required daily demo assessment completes in under 180 seconds.

Measured local sample-to-visible-update latency on /mission/live using the local self-check capture path (no backend call). Five consecutive runs from user action to the visible confirmation/timeline update: 148.23, 97.76, 116.30, 86.53, 84.55 ms (median 97.76 ms, max 148.23 ms). Network capture during the measurement recorded zero requests to the backend origin or /api/, confirming the visible update requires no cloud round-trip. Latency was measured against locally captured/synthetic input only; target-hardware wearable timing is not included.
Target-hardware battery drain cannot be truthfully measured without selected wearable hardware; limitation is documented for final evidence collection.
